description: A real report in Japanese scoped to the [bug, docs, duplicate] taxonomy. The warrant configures `languages: [en, vi, zh, ja]`; detection narrows to [zh, ja] by script and resolves to Japanese by profile, so the Han that Japanese shares with Chinese does not cost a wrong answer. The verdict names `duplicate` at 0.95 and points at #7, the warrant grants `label, comment, close`, and the run applies `duplicate`, closes the thread and posts the attribution marker — the whole duplicate-detection-and-close pipeline on a non-Latin thread.
warrant:
version: 1
labels:
  - name: bug
    description: Something that used to work and does not.
  - name: duplicate
    description: Repeats an existing thread.
  - name: question
    description: Asks for help or guidance.
languages:
  - en
  - vi
  - zh
  - ja
duties:
  triage: [label, comment, close]

thread.title: ページを再読み込みするとダークモードが保存されません
thread.body: ページを再読み込みするとダークモードの設定が保存されません。設定画面で確認しましたが、ページを開くたびに初期状態に戻ってしまいます。早急に修正していただきたいです。

verdict-over.rationale: 既存の報告 #7 と同じ内容です。
